SCRIPT
 import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = {
    'Year': [2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010],
    'Region': ['Port Vila', 'Port Vila', 'Port Vila', 'Port Vila', 'Luganville', 'Luganville',
               'Luganville', 'Luganville', 'Luganville', 'Port Vila', 'Port Vila'],
    'Tax Category': [
        'Trade Taxes', 'Trade Taxes', 'Consumption Taxes', 'Consumption Taxes',
        'Trade Taxes', 'Income Taxes', 'Consumption Taxes', 'Income Taxes',
        'Property Taxes', 'Income Taxes', 'Consumption Taxes'
    ],
    'Tax Type': [
        'Import Tariffs', 'Export Duties', 'VAT', 'Excise Taxes',
        'Import Tariffs', 'Income Tax (Individuals)', 'VAT', 'Income Tax (Businesses)',
        'Property Taxes', 'Income Tax (Individuals)', 'GST'
    ],
    'Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)': [
        142.3, 71.8, 168.5, 129.2, 67.8, 72.3, 175.9, 78.6, 55.4,
        85.2, 190.1
    ],
    'GDP Contribution (%)': [
        2.8, 1.5, 3.3, 2.6, 3.0, 1.5, 3.5, 1.6, 1.2, 1.7, 3.8
    ]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

color_revenue = '#1f77b4'
color_gdp = '#ff7f0e'

ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)', color=color_revenue, fontsize=12)
ax1.plot(df['Year'] - 0.2, df['Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)'],
        color=color_revenue, label='Tax Revenue', alpha=0.8)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_revenue)

ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.set_ylabel('GDP Contribution (%)', color=color_gdp, fontsize=12)
ax2.plot(df['Year'], df['GDP Contribution (%)'], color=color_gdp, marker='o',
         label='GDP Contribution', linewidth=2)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_gdp)

for i, year in enumerate(df['Year']):
    ax2.annotate(f"{df['GDP Contribution (%)'].iloc[i]}%",
                 xy=(year, df['GDP Contribution (%)'].iloc[i]),
                 xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points',
                 color=color_gdp, fontsize=9)

plt.title('Population Growth and Literacy Rate in Fiji (2000-2010)', fontsize=14, pad=20)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.legend(loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.1, 0.92))
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
plt.savefig('output.png')

SUMMARY
 This chart provides a detailed visualization of tax revenue and its contribution to GDP in Vanuatu from the year 2000 to 2010. It is a multi-axes chart that combines bar and line graphs to represent two distinct data sets. The horizontal axis, labeled "Year," spans from 2000 to 2010, marking each year individually. The left vertical axis, labeled "Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)," measures the tax revenue in millions of Vatu, while the right vertical axis, labeled "GDP Contribution (%)," tracks the percentage contribution of tax revenue to GDP.

The bars, colored in a rich blue shade, depict the annual tax revenue. In 2000, the tax revenue was approximately 142.3 million Vatu, which then saw a significant drop in 2001 to around 71.8 million Vatu. A notable increase is observed in 2002, reaching about 168.5 million Vatu, followed by fluctuations in subsequent years. The revenue dipped again in 2004 to 129.2 million Vatu, peaked in 2006 at 175.9 million Vatu, and after a decline, rose sharply to 190.1 million Vatu by 2010.

The orange line graph with circular markers illustrates the GDP contribution percentage over the same period. Starting at 2.8% in 2000, it dropped to 1.5% in 2001, then increased to 3.3% in 2002. After some fluctuations, including a low of 1.5% in 2005, it peaked at 3.5% in 2006. The lowest recorded GDP contribution within this period was 1.2% in 2008, and it concluded at a high of 3.8% in 2010.

The chart's title, "Tax Revenue and GDP Contribution in Vanuatu (2000-2010)," succinctly summarizes the visualized data. The combination of bar and line graphs effectively highlights the trends and variations in both tax revenue and its contribution to the GDP over the decade. Annotations on the line graph provide exact GDP contribution percentages for each year, enhancing the clarity and precision of the data presented. The chart also includes a grid with dashed lines to aid in visual alignment and comparison.

p = Path("chart.py")
s = p.read_text()
start = s.index("data = {")
end = s.index("fig, ax1")
s = s[:start] + "df = pd.read_csv('table.csv')\n\n" + s[end:]
s = s.replace("ax1.plot(df['Year'] - 0.2, df['Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)'],",
              "ax1.bar(df['Year'], df['Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)'],")
s = s.replace("ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)",
              "ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)\nax1.set_xticks(df['Year'])")
s = s.replace("Population Growth and Literacy Rate in Fiji (2000-2010)",
              "Tax Revenue and GDP Contribution in Vanuatu (2000-2010)")
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s, "chart.py", "exec"))
print("Title:", ax1.get_title())
print("Year ticks:", ax1.get_xticks())
print("Bar values:", [bar.get_height() for bar in ax1.patches])
print("Bar centers:", [bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2 for bar in ax1.patches])
print("GDP values:", ax2.lines[0].get_ydata())
print("Y limits:", ax1.get_ylim(), ax2.get_ylim())
print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in fig.legends[0].get_texts()])

import numpy as np
assert ax2.get_title() == 'Tax Revenue and GDP Contribution in Vanuatu (2000-2010)'
np.testing.assert_allclose([p.get_height() for p in ax1.patches], df['Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)'])
np.testing.assert_allclose([p.get_x() + p.get_width()/2 for p in ax1.patches], df['Year'])
np.testing.assert_allclose(ax2.lines[0].get_xdata(), df['Year'])
np.testing.assert_allclose(ax2.lines[0].get_ydata(), df['GDP Contribution (%)'])
assert ax2.lines[0].get_color() == '#ff7f0e'
assert ax1.get_ylabel() == 'Tax Revenue (Million Vatu)'
assert ax2.get_ylabel() == 'GDP Contribution (%)'
assert Path("output.png").exists()
print("All checks passed. chart.py and output.png are ready.")
